notes.title: "DreamyPoems" Purchase Experience Guidelines
notes.content:
Dear players,

Thank you for your interest and support in "DreamyPoems"! Before making a purchase, please carefully read the following guidelines to enhance your gaming experience:

1. Unique Joy of Elimination: In "DreamyPoems", we have replaced traditional patterns with poetic text for elimination. You will experience a whole new joy of elimination by matching and eliminating identical verses. Enjoy the fusion of text and poetic charm!

2. Language Settings and Gameplay: In the game, text can be considered as a form of graphics. Therefore, language settings do not affect the appearance of poetic text during gameplay. Language settings only affect non-game UI text. You can choose your preferred language based on personal preference.

3. Explore Chinese Poetry and Culture: "DreamyPoems" incorporates rich elements of Chinese poetry and culture, allowing you to experience the unique charm of Chinese culture in the game. By connecting verses and unlocking poetry, you will gain a deeper understanding of the beauty of Chinese poetry.

Thank you for choosing "DreamyPoems". We hope you enjoy the unique joy of elimination and experience the charm of Chinese poetry and culture in the game. If you have any questions or concerns, please feel free to contact our customer service team.

Have a great gaming experience!

The "DreamyPoems" Team
